The predicate is `isEnabled(flag, ctx)` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. I checked each `src` match for a real call, not just an import or a comment. Files that only mention it in comments or render `FeatureGate`/`useFeatureFlag` (which go through `readFlag`) are excluded. `src/lib/feature-flags.ts` is included because `snapshotFlags` and `assertEnabled` call `isEnabled` directly. `readFlag` in `src/hooks/flag-context.ts` is included because it falls back to `isEnabled`. `scripts/` only lists `isEnabled` in manifest metadata, so those files are not counted.
